requirements.text: The system shall display the main navigation page containing three login options.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall display the main navigation page containing three login options: Option 1: Admin Login Option 2: Teacher Login Option 3: Student Login

requirements.text: The system shall redirect the user to the appropriate dashboard when a login option is clicked.
requirements.evidence_quote: When the user clicks on any of the three options, the system shall redirect them to their respective login page: Admin →Admin Dashboard Teacher →Teacher Dashboard Student →Student Dashboard

requirements.text: The main page shall include About, Contact, and Help buttons or links.
requirements.evidence_quote: The main page shall also include the following buttons or links: About: Displays brief information about the system. Contact: Shows contact details for support or queries. Help: Provides FAQs or user guidance.

requirements.text: After successful login, the system shall open the Teacher Dashboard showing quick links to Attendance, Grading, and Announcements.
requirements.evidence_quote: After successful login, the system shall open the Teacher Dashboard showing quick links to Attendance, Grading, and Announcements.

requirements.text: After successful login, the system shall open the Admin Dashboard with titles for Student Management, Teacher Management, Teacher Assignment, Announcements, and Reporting.
